manual: Enable 1Password CLI integration and its SSH agent; lock/unlock if the new agent configuration is not recognized.
Approve Karabiner, WinMux, and Hammerspoon permissions in System Settings.
Run wm-toggle on after WinMux Accessibility approval; verify Caps Lock shortcuts.
Open Hammerspoon; verify Control-Option-Space with your chosen app.
Open Finicky, select it as the default web browser, and verify routing.
Sign in to Tailscale and approve its VPN/system extension; AgentsView waits for it.

AgentsView uses port 18082 on this Mac's Tailscale address; save its newly generated auth_token from ~/.local/share/agentsview-nix/config.toml to 1Password locally, then register this new spoke on your hub.
AgentsView preserves --no-sync behavior; the new archive starts empty and existing history is not copied.
Run colab sessions to complete Google OAuth sign-in; this does not create a runtime.
For Colab SSH, authorize the exported public key on the runtime, start its tunnel, then run colab-ssh-config CURRENT.trycloudflare.com and verify the runtime host-key fingerprint.
Verify GitHub access and the oracle-ts jump host before testing ganymede2 and juno; remote access and MFA are not proven by local checks.
Verify comma/comma3, oracle, alan-mac-studio and work-mbp access; their existing agent-based key selection is preserved.
Sign in to browsers/Basecamp and activate BetterDisplay if needed; use supported sync/export for private profiles.
After App Store sign-in, run scripts/install-app-store.sh for Fantastical, Slack and WhatsApp.
